title: Bump the tooling pins to the released 0.11.0: managed Quest block, schemas; audit release.yml version strings (OPAG-472)
description: opum-agent OPAG-472 (dispatch 2026-09-27): lore 0.11.0 and quest 0.11.0 are released (npm latest 0.11.0 for both, read 2026-09-27). The managed Quest block in CLAUDE.md still declares Quest CLI 0.10.0, and ci.yml installs the quest version that block declares, so CI's quest lags the released pair. The dispatch also named release.yml as installing @opum-ai/lore at 0.7.0, 0.6.2 and 0.6.1; judge whether those are deliberate before touching them.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The managed Quest block declares Quest CLI 0.11.0, regenerated by quest agents --update-instructions --target claude with every changed byte between the managed markers, and quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude exits 0
Every 0.7.0/0.6.2/0.6.1 occurrence in release.yml is classified (install pin vs dated evidence) and the decision is recorded on this task
lore schema export under 0.11.0 leaves .lore/schemas either unchanged or updated in this same change
bun run lore check exits 0 and bun test passes on the PR head

implementationNotes: RELEASE.YML DECISION: nothing to bump. release.yml installs no @opum-ai/lore at any version. Every 0.7.0/0.6.2/0.6.1 occurrence is dated evidence inside a comment: line 621 (npm view @opum-ai/lore@0.7.0 readme served a README asserting 0.6.2 -- why the shipped-README gate exists), line 704 (versions published before 0.6.1 pin a commit destroyed by the 2026-09-10 recreation -- the provenance re-verify's KNOWN_DANGLING_THROUGH rationale), lines 1181-1183 (the 2026-09-15 measurement that npm readme is package-level, three versions returning the same 14446 bytes). Rewriting them to 0.11.0 would falsify dated measurements (history; retirement-scope rule). The workflow's real installs are version-free: npm@^11 (OIDC floor) and the job's own tarballs. The pinned tool that DOES follow a version string is ci.yml's quest install, which reads the managed block, so regenerating the block to 0.11.0 is what moves CI's quest. SCHEMAS: lore schema export under the installed 0.11.0 binary and from source (bun run lore schema export) both left .lore/schemas byte-identical; nothing to commit. LORE CHECK on 0.11.0 CONFIRMED rather than assumed: installed /Users/.../bin/lore --version 0.11.0 'lore check' exit 0 (82 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings), and bun run lore check exit 0 with the same count. quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude exit 0 after regeneration; the only CLAUDE.md diff is the version line inside the managed block.
